name: Official HEB export
notes: Official app exports 156 main parameter words plus 192 extended/CAN words into a 696-byte file.

name: Worthless HEB export

conflicts.summary: Official exports main + extended blocks; Worthless fills only the main block.

notes: Worthless writes a 696-byte HEB but only populates the first 156 words, leaving the extended/CAN block unreliable as a backup.
